name: Money20/20 USA
segment_evidence: Payments-first show: organizer lists banks, payments, tech, retail and startups; PSPs and fintechs are a primary audience alongside banks.
persona_evidence: 1 in 3 attendees is C-suite (organizer), but spread across banks, vendors and tech as well as payments companies.
fx_evidence: 'Borderless Financial Architecture' (cross-border modernisation) is one of the four 2026 content pillars.
concentration_evidence: Very broad 11,000+ crowd (banking, fraud, retail, crypto): Grain-relevant people are a small fraction.
data_confidence_note: Organizer publishes C-suite share and sector list.

name: Money20/20 Europe
segment_evidence: Payments-first show: organizer lists banks, payments, tech, startups and retail as its core sectors.
persona_evidence: 1 in 3 attendees is C-suite (organizer), spread across banks, vendors, policy, crypto and cyber as well as payments.
fx_evidence: Pan-European room from 100+ countries; European payments firms are inherently multi-currency (our reading). Cross-border is not a named 2026 pillar.
concentration_evidence: Broad crowd: the organizer's sector list runs to policy, crypto and cyber security.
data_confidence_note: Organizer publishes C-suite share and sector list; FX rating is our inference.

name: Merchant Payments Ecosystem (MPE)
segment_evidence: Built around merchants meeting PSPs and acquirers: 500+ merchants plus PSPs, acquirers, fintechs and networks (organizer).
persona_evidence: Aimed at senior payments decision-makers at merchants and PSPs; programme includes merchant treasury and finance.
fx_evidence: 'Cross-border & global commerce' is a named programme theme: global acquiring, FX, local payment methods, international settlement.
concentration_evidence: Niche 1,600-person room where nearly everyone works in payments.
data_confidence_note: Organizer quantifies merchants vs total and lists attendee types.

name: Sibos
segment_evidence: Bank/FI-dominated audience (200+ international banks, central banks, market infrastructures); cross-border fintechs and PSPs attend but are a minority, so the banks anchor gives Segment 1.
persona_evidence: Payments and transaction-banking leaders attend in numbers, mostly from banks; payments heads from fintechs and PSPs attend alongside them.
fx_evidence: Cross-border payments is the headline theme of Swift's own event; the 2025 agenda was dominated by it.
concentration_evidence: 12,500+ participants, mostly bankers: Grain-relevant people are a small fraction.
data_confidence_note: Attendee types described, no shares published.

name: The Phocuswright Conference
audience_size: ~1,200 attendees (2024 record; total not published on site)
audience_size_basis: Phocuswright marketing director, quoted by Vendelux
segment_evidence: Travel companies and platforms are the primary audience (Expedia, Booking Holdings, Airbnb, Trip.com); 2026 programme features B2B distribution.
persona_evidence: 65% C-level or VP (organizer): commercial and product leaders at travel platforms attend, alongside marketers, tech vendors and investors.
fx_evidence: OTAs and global travel platforms are inherently multi-currency (our reading); payments and FX are not a programme theme.
concentration_evidence: Senior travel-industry room of ~1,200: platforms are a large share, alongside suppliers, destinations and vendors.
data_confidence_note: Organizer publishes seniority shares and segments; attendance figure is second-hand.

name: ITB Berlin
segment_evidence: The whole travel industry: tour operators, travel tech (6+ halls) and hospitality, alongside destinations and tourism boards. Grain's travel segments are a big part, not the whole.
persona_evidence: The ITB Buyers Circle brings senior decision-makers from 63 countries, but most of the floor is exhibitor sales and marketing staff.
fx_evidence: International travel trade across 160+ countries: inbound and outbound travel businesses are inherently multi-currency.
concentration_evidence: ~97,000 attendees across every travel sector: relevant people are a small fraction.
data_confidence_note: Segments and halls described; no role shares published.

name: IATA World Financial Symposium & World Passenger Symposium
segment_evidence: Mixed airline finance, retailing and passenger-experience audience (75+ airlines plus providers and banks); airlines are FX-exposed travel businesses, but the room is not primarily our Core travel-platform/wholesaler segments.
persona_evidence: WFS draws airline finance and payments leaders, but it is co-located with the Passenger Symposium (retailing, passenger experience).
fx_evidence: The 2026 finance track covers 'managing volatility... hedging and financial risk management, controlling payment costs'.
concentration_evidence: Niche aviation room of ~1,250, split between finance and passenger/retail audiences.
data_confidence_note: Attendee types described with airline count; no role shares.

name: EuroFinance International Treasury Management
segment_evidence: International corporate treasury is the focused audience, and treasury is one of Grain's core segments.
persona_evidence: 60% in leadership roles: group treasurers, C-level, directors and heads (organizer).
fx_evidence: FX & commodities hedging and cross-border payments are dedicated programme streams at an international-treasury event.
concentration_evidence: Mostly corporate treasurers, but with a large bank and vendor presence ('94% of corporates discovered new vendors').
data_confidence_note: Organizer publishes leadership share and audience type.

name: AFP Annual Conference
audience_size: 7,000+ treasury, payments, FP&A and corporate finance professionals
segment_evidence: Broad cross-industry corporate treasury and finance audience; treasury is central, but the organizer does not establish FX-exposed businesses as the primary company mix.
persona_evidence: Treasurers, controllers and CFOs are core audience roles (organizer).
fx_evidence: About a dozen FX and cross-border sessions within a broad treasury, FP&A and payments programme; mostly domestic.
concentration_evidence: 7,000+ attendees from analysts to CFOs, including FP&A and accounting: FX-exposed treasurers are a small fraction.
data_confidence_note: Roles listed without shares; FX count from session catalogue.

name: Fintech Meetup
segment_evidence: Mixed fintech and bank/credit-union room (1,000+ CEOs and founders, 700+ financial institutions), rated as broad fintech rather than FI-dominated. Payments is present (Head of Payments is a listed role) but not the focus.
persona_evidence: 40% C-level and 25% VP (organizer), but mostly bank, credit-union and fintech CEOs; payments buyers attend alongside many others.
fx_evidence: US-centric programme (2027 theme 'Built on Trust': AI, fraud, compliance); no cross-border track.
concentration_evidence: US banks, credit unions and fintechs make up most of the room; Grain-relevant people are a small fraction (the double-opt-in meetings help target them).
data_confidence_note: Organizer publishes a job-level breakdown and sector list.

name: Marketplace Risk Management Conference
segment_evidence: Marketplaces and platforms (Amazon, Uber, eBay, Walmart, Stripe), but a generic marketplace audience: marketplaces count as core only when payments or FX are central, so this is adjacent.
persona_evidence: Trust & safety, risk, fraud, compliance and legal roles: not Grain's finance, commercial or payments buyers.
fx_evidence: Risk and trust & safety programme; cross-border payments and FX are not a theme.
concentration_evidence: The companies fit, but the roles don't: likely FX buyers are a small fraction of the room.
data_confidence_note: Roles and companies described; no shares published.

name: SaaStr AI Annual
segment_evidence: Broad B2B software and AI: software platforms where payments are central are a small minority.
persona_evidence: Founders, CROs, CMOs, CCOs and VCs: revenue and marketing roles, not finance or payments buyers.
fx_evidence: No payments, FX or cross-border content in the programme description.
concentration_evidence: 10,000+ attendees: Grain-relevant people are a small fraction.

name: iFX EXPO Dubai
audience_size_basis: Organizer figures quoted by Khaleej Times
segment_evidence: Online trading brokers, prop firms and affiliates are outside Grain's segments; PSPs attend as vendors to brokers, a minority.
persona_evidence: Broker executives, affiliates/IBs and traders: not buyers of Grain's product.
fx_evidence: 'FX' here is the product traded, not a currency-risk problem; the real link is that brokers' client funding is multi-currency.
concentration_evidence: Grain-relevant people (some PSPs) are a small fraction of the room.
data_confidence_note: Attendee types described, no shares published. 2027 dates as published on the organizer's 2027 site (dubai2027.ifxexpo.com), checked 25 Sep 2026.
